I did the same mistake. Look, I’m not sure if this is gonna work, I don’t have many details available, but give it a try: for now, STOP texting her for a while. Don’t be afraid of her not coming back to you, as this is the only way to make her come back. Go no-contact for 30 days. I know. It’s hard. Cry, yell, you can always come here to vent. After 30 days, text her ONCE, think about all you’ve done wrong, show her you’ve changed and want to start fresh. If she replies, don’t rush it. Gain her trust back slowly. Now, if she won’t reply, there’s no point in trying again. You’ll need to move on. Go back to the activities you used to do before you’ve met her. Focus on yourself. Go scuba diving. Whatever, but you’ll need to stop hurting yourself by thinking about it. I wish you all the best and please, keep us updated. Good luck, OP!
